tool_schemas.name: grounding_2d
tool_schemas.description:

Input: Object name or referring expression, e.g. the red block left of the bowl.

Camera: Uses saved RGB only; camera parameters are neither required nor accepted.
Usage: Use the chosen center_row_col with sample_world_xyz on exactly the returned step_idx/view to look up a measured world point before constructing an atomic motion target.
Limitations: A box is not a world pose, grasp pose or verified object identity. Its center may sample background or an occluder; check the source image and validity of world-map samples. Read-only VLM estimates may be inaccurate. Does not execute actions, advance state or capture new observations. Not sensor ground truth, a collision check or official task success. On an error or uncertain result, inspect the real image and do not treat failure as a valid prediction.

tool_schemas.name: trace_2d
tool_schemas.description:
Purpose: Predict a proposed robot end-effector trajectory projected into one saved RGB image.
Input: Full manipulation task instruction, e.g. Pick up the red block and place it in the bowl. The requested trajectory belongs to the gripper, not the moved object.

Camera: Uses saved RGB only; camera parameters are neither required nor accepted.

tool_schemas.name: trace_3d

tool_schemas.name: grounding_3d
tool_schemas.description:
Purpose: Estimate oriented 3D boxes for named objects in one calibrated saved RGB image.
Input: Object category or referring expression, e.g. the mug beside the plate. Requests object position, dimensions and orientation, not a grasp or motion.
Returns: found and detections with label, bbox_3d, center_xyz_m, size_xyz_m, rpy_over_pi and rpy_rad. bbox_3d is a list containing one 9-value center/size/rotation vector per detection. Successful calls also include image_size, step_idx, view, step_indices, source_image_sha256 and action_executed=false.

tool_schemas.name: video_grounding_3d
tool_schemas.description:
Purpose: Estimate 3D boxes for all instances of a category visible across ordered saved frames.
Input: Object category to locate across the sequence, e.g. chair. Supply steps with 2..64 strictly increasing saved indices and one shared view; dimensions and intrinsics must match across the selected frames.
Returns: found and detections with label, bbox_3d, center_xyz_m, size_xyz_m, rpy_over_pi and rpy_rad. One combined list of predicted instances, not one result per frame. Also includes frame_count and reference_step_idx for the last selected observation. Successful calls also include image_size, step_idx, view, step_indices, source_image_sha256 and action_executed=false.
Coordinates: All centers and zero-rotation sizes use meters in last_frame_camera_cv, with x right, y down, z forward. Rotations are Euler/pi plus radians, with composition order unspecified. world_transform_applied=false; earlier-frame camera coordinates are not used.
Camera: Requires real saved intrinsic_K and image dimensions for the selected view/step. Missing or inconsistent calibration is an error; never invent camera parameters.
Usage: Use several observations over time to resolve object presence and spatial extent. Verify predictions against the recorded images. Any world conversion must use the last selected step's real camera extrinsics, not the first frame's pose or an invented identity matrix.
Limitations: Not tracking IDs, per-frame boxes, velocities or trajectories. An instance visible earlier can lie behind the final camera, so negative final-camera z is not automatically invalid. Estimates are not grasp poses or executable world targets; no new video is captured. Read-only VLM estimates may be inaccurate. Does not execute actions, advance state or capture new observations. Not sensor ground truth, a collision check or official task success. On an error or uncertain result, inspect the real image and do not treat failure as a valid prediction.

tool_schemas.name: depth_estimation
tool_schemas.description:
Purpose: Estimate one object's, existing visible marker's or image point's distance from the camera.
Input: Object referring string (e.g. the red cup), or {"kind":"object","name":"..."}, {"kind":"marker","marker":"A"}, or {"kind":"point","point_xy_1000":[500,400]}. Supported markers: A/B/C/D/red_dot/red_arrow; the requested marker must already be visible.
Returns: found and one depths entry containing depth_m, reported_value, reported_unit, unit_source and query. Successful calls also include image_size, step_idx, view, step_indices, source_image_sha256 and action_executed=false.

No safe approach distance or successful contact is guaranteed. Read-only VLM estimates may be inaccurate. Does not execute actions, advance state or capture new observations.
